data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the same order (Flights tab, trip type, origin and destination, dates and Done, Search, sort by Fastest, See flight, Select, Next) and covers multi-city; it is slightly short on passengers and filters as parameters and uses a legs structure, but it is concrete enough to automate.
